source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 3 (PDF 51-93), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 3 (Cells and Subcellular Organelles) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.
3.1 Cells: the basic unit of life

blocks.prompt:
1 How many basic properties of life are shown by all living organisms?
(Tamam jandaar kitni bunyadi life properties (zindagi ki khususiyat) dikhate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Tamam jandaar saat bunyadi properties dikhate hain: movement, respiration, homeostasis, growth, reproduction, excretion aur nutrition (3.1).

book_ref.quote: all living organisms show the seven basic properties of life

blocks.prompt:
2 In amoebas and bacteria, the functions necessary for life are carried out by:
(Amoeba aur bacteria mein zindagi ke zaroori kaam kaun anjaam deta hai?)

options.text: bohat se khaas cells mil kar

blocks.explanation: Unicellular (yak khaliyati) jandaaron jaise amoeba aur bacteria mein aik hi cell zindagi ke tamam zaroori kaam karta hai (3.1).

book_ref.quote: a single cell carries out all the functions necessary for life

blocks.prompt:
3 During respiration, cells break glucose to release:
(Respiration (tanaffus) mein cells glucose ko tor kar kya kharij karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Respiration glucose ko tor kar ATP kharij karti hai, jo cell ki energy currency hai (3.1).

book_ref.quote: This process breaks glucose to release ATP

blocks.prompt:
4 Gametes for sexual reproduction are produced by:
(Sexual reproduction ke gametes (tolidi khaliye) kis amal se bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mitosis growth aur marammat ke liye aik jaise daughter cells banata hai, jab ke meiosis gametes banata hai (3.1).

book_ref.quote: while meiosis creates gametes for sexual reproduction

blocks.prompt:
5 Cells remove their waste products and prevent toxic buildup through:
(Cells apne waste products kis tarah nikalte hain taa ke zehreele maadde jama na hon?)
blocks.explanation: Excretion: cells diffusion aur active transport se waste nikalte hain taa ke zehreele maadde jama na hon (3.1).

book_ref.quote: Cells remove waste products through diffusion and active transport

blocks.prompt:
6 Cells maintain a stable internal environment (homeostasis) by:
(Cells andar ka mustahkam mahol (homeostasis) kaise qaim rakhte hain?)

options.text: membranes ke aar paar maaddon ki harkat control kar ke
nucleus mein glycogen jama kar ke

blocks.explanation: Homeostasis: cells apni membranes ke aar paar maaddon ki harkat ko control kar ke andar ka mahol mustahkam rakhte hain (3.1).

book_ref.quote: by regulating the movement of substances across their membranes

blocks.prompt:
7 In 1665, Robert Hooke observed "many little boxes" in a thin slice of:
(1665 mein Robert Hooke ne "many little boxes" kis cheez ke patle tukre mein dekhe?)
blocks.explanation: Hooke ne oak darakht ke cork ka patla tukra dekha aur maloom kiya ke yeh bohat se chhote dabbon se bana hai (3.2).

book_ref.quote: examined a thin slice of cork of oak tree under microscope

blocks.prompt:
8 Robert Hooke named the compartments he saw in plant parts as:
(Robert Hooke ne paudon ke hisson mein dekhe gaye khaanon ka kya naam rakha?)
blocks.explanation: Hooke ne nateeja nikala ke paudon ke hisse khaanon se bane hain aur unhein "cellulae" ka naam diya (3.2).

book_ref.quote: Hooke named these compartments as

blocks.prompt:
9 Anton van Leeuwenhoek observed living cells in pond water and called them:
(Anton van Leeuwenhoek ne talaab ke paani mein zinda cells dekh kar unhein kya kaha?)
blocks.explanation: 1673 mein Leeuwenhoek ne behtar microscope banaya, talaab ke paani mein zinda cells dekhe aur unhein animalcules kaha (3.2).

book_ref.quote: observed living cells in pond water

blocks.prompt:
10 The nucleus in the cell was discovered in 1831 by:
(1831 mein cell mein nucleus kis ne daryaft kiya?)
blocks.explanation: 1831 mein British botanist Robert Brown ne cell mein nucleus daryaft kiya (3.2).

book_ref.quote: in 1831 the British botanist Robert Brown discovered nucleus in the cell

blocks.prompt:
11 The German botanist who concluded in 1838 that all plants are composed of cells was:
(Woh German botanist kaun tha jis ne 1838 mein nateeja nikala ke tamam paude cells se bane hain?)
blocks.explanation: 1838 mein Matthias Schleiden ne kaha ke tamam paude cells se bane hain; agle saal Schwann ne yahi baat janwaron ke liye kahi (3.2).

book_ref.quote: He concluded that all plants were composed of cells

blocks.prompt:
12 Theodor Schwann, who concluded that animals are composed of cells, was a:
(Theodor Schwann, jis ne kaha ke janwar cells se bane hain, kaun tha?)
blocks.explanation: German zoologist (mahir-e-haiwanat) Theodor Schwann ne janwaron ke liye wohi nateeja nikala jo Schleiden ne paudon ke liye nikala tha (3.2).

book_ref.quote: the German zoologist Theodor Schwann concluded the same for animals

blocks.prompt:
13 The German physician who observed that all cells come from other cells was:
(Woh German physician kaun tha jis ne dekha ke tamam cells doosre cells se aate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Rudolf Virchow ne dekha ke tamam cells doosre cells se aate hain (omnis cellula e cellula). Kitaab ka saal 1885 ghalat chhapa hai; yeh 1855 mein kaha gaya (3.2).

book_ref.quote: observed that all cells come from other cells

blocks.prompt:
14 Experimental proof that cells come from other cells was provided in 1862 by:
(1862 mein is baat ka tajurbati saboot kis ne diya ke cells doosre cells se aate hain?)
blocks.explanation: 1862 mein Louis Pasteur ne tajurbe se saabit kiya ke tamam cells doosre cells se aate hain (3.2).

book_ref.quote: Louis Pasteur provided the experimental proof of this idea

blocks.prompt:
15 Which statement is one of the three points of the cell theory?
(Inmein se kaun si baat cell theory ke teen nukaat mein se aik hai?)

options.text: Har cell mein cell wall hoti hai
Har cell mein nucleus hota hai
Cells jandaar mein structure aur function ki bunyadi units hain
Cells be-jaan maadde se bante hain

blocks.explanation: Cell theory kehti hai: tamam jandaar cells se bane hain; cells structure aur function ki bunyadi units hain; cells sirf pehle se maujood cells se bante hain (3.2).

book_ref.quote: Cells are the basic units of structure and function in an organism.

blocks.prompt:
16 Viruses are an exception to the cell theory because they:
(Viruses cell theory ki exception (istisna) kyun hain?)

options.text: aik cytoplasm mein bohat se nuclei rakhte hain
binary fission se taqseem hote hain
cells se nahi bane aur nakal ke liye host cell chahiye

blocks.explanation: Viruses cells se nahi bane, khud zindagi ke kaam nahi kar sakte aur apni nakal ke liye host cell ke mohtaaj hain (3.2).

book_ref.quote: They require a host cell to replicate

blocks.prompt:
17 Mitochondria and chloroplasts have their own DNA and replicate independently. This suggests that they:
(Mitochondria aur chloroplasts ka apna DNA hai aur yeh khud nakal karte hain. Is se kya andaza hota hai?)

options.text: shayad azad prokaryotic cells se bane

blocks.explanation: Apna DNA aur khud nakal is taraf ishara hai ke yeh organelles shayad azad rehne wale prokaryotic cells se bane (3.2).

book_ref.quote: may have originated from free-living prokaryotic cells

blocks.prompt:
18 Vertebrate muscle cells (myocytes) challenge the concept of a single cell as the basic unit because they:
(Vertebrate muscle cells (myocytes) aik cell ke bunyadi unit hone ke tasawwur ko kyun challenge karte hain?)

options.text: jur kar kayi nuclei wale fibres banate hain

blocks.explanation: Myocytes aapas mein jur kar kayi nuclei wale fibres banate hain, jo aik cell ke bunyadi unit hone ke khayal ko challenge karta hai (3.2).

book_ref.quote: can fuse to form multinucleated fibres

blocks.prompt:
19 Live-cell imaging and genetic studies validate which principle of the cell theory?
(Live-cell imaging aur genetic studies cell theory ke kis usool ki tasdeeq karte hain?)

options.text: Cells sirf proteins se bane hain
Cells be-jaan maadde se bante hain
Har cell pehle se maujood cell se banta hai

blocks.explanation: Yeh techniques dekhti hain ke cells kaise nakal kar ke naye cells banate hain, is se saabit hota hai ke har cell pehle se maujood cell se banta hai (3.2).

book_ref.quote: techniques like live-cell imaging and genetic studies

blocks.prompt:
20 The technique that reveals that cells share common genetic material and metabolic pathways is:
(Kaun si technique batati hai ke cells ka genetic material aur metabolic raaste mushtarka hain?)
blocks.explanation: DNA sequencing dikhati hai ke cells ka genetic material aur metabolic pathways aik jaise hain, is se cell ke zindagi ki bunyadi unit hone ki tasdeeq hoti hai (3.2).

book_ref.quote: Techniques like DNA sequencing reveal that cells share common genetic material

blocks.prompt:
21 The technique of using microscopes to observe objects too small for the naked eye is called:
(Nangi aankh se na dikhne wali cheezon ko microscope se dekhne ki technique ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Microscopy woh technique hai jis mein microscope se woh cheezein dekhi jaati hain jo nangi aankh se nazar nahi aatin (3.3).

book_ref.quote: Microscopy is the technique of using microscopes to observe and study objects

blocks.prompt:
22 The total magnification of a microscope is determined by:
(Microscope ki total magnification kaise maloom hoti hai?)

options.text: tamam lenses ki magnification jama kar ke
tamam lenses ki magnification ko zarb kar ke
resolution ko magnification par taqseem kar ke

blocks.explanation: Total magnification tamam lenses ki magnification ko aapas mein zarb (multiply) kar ke maloom hoti hai (3.3).

book_ref.quote: Total magnification in a microscope is determined by multiplying the magnification of all lenses

blocks.prompt:
23 A microscope's ability to distinguish between two points that are close together on an object is called its:
(Microscope ki woh salahiyat jis se woh object par qareeb qareeb do points ko alag alag dikha sake, kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Resolution qareeb do points ko alag pehchanne ki salahiyat hai; resolution jitni zyada, utni bareek tafseel nazar aati hai (3.3).

book_ref.quote: ability to distinguish between two points that are close together on an object

blocks.prompt:
24 The resolution of the naked human eye is about:
(Insani nangi aankh ki resolution taqreeban kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nangi aankh taqreeban 0.1 mm tak alag dekh sakti hai, jab ke light microscope taqreeban 250 nm tak (3.3).

book_ref.quote: The naked human eye has a resolution of about 0.1 mm

blocks.prompt:
25 In a light microscope, after passing through the object, light passes through:
(Light microscope mein object se guzarne ke baad light kis cheez se guzarti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Light object se aur phir do sheeshe ke lenses se guzarti hai; aik image bari karta hai aur doosra mazeed bara karta hai (3.3).

book_ref.quote: Light passes through object and then through two glass lenses

blocks.prompt:
26 The magnification of a light microscope, as given in the chapter, is about:
(Chapter ke mutabiq light microscope ki magnification taqreeban kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Light microscope ki magnification 1500X hai, yani yeh cheezon ko taqreeban 1500 guna bara dikhata hai (3.3).

book_ref.quote: The magnification of a light microscope is 1500X

blocks.prompt:
27 A light microscope cannot distinguish objects smaller than:
(Light microscope kis size se chhoti cheezon ko alag nahi dikha sakta?)
blocks.explanation: Light microscope ki resolving power 0.2 µm hai (1 µm = 1/1000 mm) (3.3).

book_ref.quote: the light microscope cannot distinguish objects smaller than 0.2 µm

blocks.prompt:
28 Cell components seen under a light microscope are coloured with special stains. A drawback of staining is that it:
(Light microscope mein cell ke hisson ko stains se rang diya jata hai. Staining ka nuqsan kya hai?)

options.text: cells ko shaffaf bana deti hai
aksar cells ko maar deti hai
electrons ki beam chahiye hoti hai

blocks.explanation: Cells aam tor par shaffaf (transparent) hote hain, is liye stains lagaye jaate hain; magar staining aksar cells ko maar deti hai (3.3).

book_ref.quote: Staining, however, usually kills the cells.

blocks.prompt:
29 In an electron microscope, the electron beam is focused by:
(Electron microscope mein electron beam ko kaun focus karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Magnetic lenses electron beam ko screen ya photographic film par focus kar ke bohat bari image banate hain (3.3).

book_ref.quote: Magnetic lenses focus the electron beam on a screen or photographic film

blocks.prompt:
30 An electron microscope can clearly show objects as small as:
(Electron microscope kitni chhoti cheez ko saaf dikha sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Electron microscope 0.2 nanometre jitni chhoti cheez saaf dikha sakta hai; 1 nm = 1/1000,000 mm (3.3).

book_ref.quote: It can clearly show objects as small as 0.2 nanometre (nm)

blocks.prompt:
31 An electron microscope cannot be used for viewing living material because:
(Electron microscope se zinda maadda kyun nahi dekha ja sakta?)

options.text: is ki magnification bohat kam hai
yeh nazar aane wali light istemal karta hai
specimen tayyar karne ke tareeqon ki wajah se
is ki resolution aankh se kam hai

blocks.explanation: Specimen tayyar karne ke tareeqon ki wajah se electron microscope se zinda maadda nahi dekha ja sakta (3.3).

book_ref.quote: electron microscope cannot be used for viewing living material

blocks.prompt:
32 A Transmission Electron Microscope (TEM) can magnify objects up to:
(Transmission Electron Microscope (TEM) cheezon ko kitna bara kar sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: TEM electrons ko bohat patle specimen mein se guzarta hai aur 250,000 guna tak bara kar sakta hai (3.3).

book_ref.quote: It can magnify objects up to 250,000 times.

blocks.prompt:
33 In a Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM), the image is made when the electron beam:
(Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM) mein image kaise banti hai?)

options.text: bohat patle specimen se guzarti hai
satah ki dhaat ki tah se reflect hoti hai
do sheeshe ke lenses se guzarti hai

blocks.explanation: SEM satah ka mutaala karta hai: satah par dhaat chadhai jaati hai, electron beam us se reflect ho kar bari image banati hai; SEM 100,000 guna tak bara karta hai (3.3).

book_ref.quote: is used to study the details of surfaces of cells or any other objects

blocks.prompt:
34 Which statement is true for the electron microscope compared with the light microscope?
(Light microscope ke muqable mein electron microscope ke baare mein kaun si baat sahi hai?)

options.text: Specimen tayyar karne mein kayi din lagte hain
Zinda aur murda dono specimen dekhe ja sakte hain
Image ocular lens se dekhi jaati hai
Yeh 400-700 nm ki light istemal karta hai

blocks.explanation: Electron microscope ke liye specimen tayyar karne mein kayi din lagte hain aur sirf murda, sukhaaye specimen dekhe jaate hain (3.3).

book_ref.quote: Specimen preparation takes several days

blocks.prompt:
35 Yeast and Euglena are examples of:
(Yeast aur Euglena kis ki misalein hain?)
blocks.explanation: Tamam bacteria prokaryotes hain; yeast aur Euglena unicellular eukaryotes hain; paude aur janwar multicellular eukaryotes hain (3.4).

book_ref.quote: Yeast and Euglena are examples of unicellular eukaryotes

blocks.prompt:
36 When the cell wall is removed by cell wall degrading enzymes, the remaining part of the cell is called:
(Jab cell wall ko enzymes se hata diya jaye to cell ka baqi hissa kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cell wall hatane ke baad cell ke baqi hisse ko protoplast kehte hain (3.4).

book_ref.quote: the remaining components of the cell are called a protoplast

blocks.prompt:
37 The primary cell wall is composed of the polysaccharides:
(Primary cell wall kin polysaccharides se bani hai?)
blocks.explanation: Primary wall cellulose, hemicellulose aur pectin se bani hai, aur is mein kayi proteins bhi hain (3.4).

book_ref.quote: It is composed of polysaccharides i.e. cellulose, hemicellulose and pectin

blocks.prompt:
38 In the primary wall, the cellulose microfibrils are aligned at all angles and are held together by:
(Primary wall mein cellulose microfibrils har zaviye par hote hain aur kis cheez se jure hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Primary wall ke cellulose microfibrils har zaviye par hote hain aur hydrogen bonds se jure rehte hain (3.4).

book_ref.quote: are held together by hydrogen bonds

blocks.prompt:
39 The middle lamella contains:
(Middle lamella mein kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Middle lamella aik jelly jaisi tah hai jis mein magnesium aur calcium pectates (pectic acid ke namak) hote hain (3.4).

book_ref.quote: It contains magnesium and calcium pectates

blocks.prompt:
40 The middle lamella is formed from:
(Middle lamella kis cheez se banti hai?)

options.text: maturation ke baad secondary wall se
cytokinesis ke dauran cell plate se

blocks.explanation: Middle lamella sab se pehle cytokinesis ke dauran cell plate se banti hai; phir primary wall is ke andar phailti hai (3.4).

book_ref.quote: formed from the cell plate during cytokinesis

blocks.prompt:
41 The secondary cell wall is more rigid than the primary wall due to the presence of:
(Secondary cell wall primary wall se zyada sakht kis cheez ki wajah se hai?)
blocks.explanation: Secondary wall mein lignin, cellulose aur hemicellulose hote hain; lignin ki wajah se yeh primary wall se zyada sakht hai (3.4).

book_ref.quote: Due to the presence of lignin, secondary wall is more rigid than the primary wall

blocks.prompt:
42 Plasmodesmata are formed during cell division when:
(Plasmodesmata cell division ke dauran kaise bante hain?)

options.text: cell plate mein lysosomes phat jaate hain
nuclear envelope wall se jur jata hai
ER ke hisse nayi cell wall mein phans jaate hain
microtubules wall ko ghol dete hain

blocks.explanation: Plasmodesmata us waqt bante hain jab parent cell ke ER ke hisse nayi cell wall mein phans jaate hain (3.4).

book_ref.quote: when parts of the endoplasmic reticulum of the parent cell get trapped in the new cell wall

blocks.prompt:
43 The cell wall of fungi is composed of:
(Fungi ki cell wall kis cheez se bani hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fungi ki cell wall chitin se bani hai, wohi carbohydrate jo keeron ke bairooni dhaanche ko mazboot karta hai (3.4).

book_ref.quote: The cell wall of fungi is composed of chitin

blocks.prompt:
44 Diatoms show high growth rates because their cell walls are made from:
(Diatoms ki tez growth ki wajah yeh hai ke un ki cell wall kis se banti hai?)

options.text: chitin, jis mein kam energy lagti hai
silicic acid (silica), jis mein kam energy lagti hai
lignin, jis mein zyada energy lagti hai

blocks.explanation: Diatoms silicic acid se cell wall banate hain; silica wall banane mein kam energy lagti hai, is liye un ki growth tez hai (3.4).

book_ref.quote: synthesize their cell walls from silicic acid

blocks.prompt:
45 Which cell wall contains no peptidoglycan?
(Kis ki cell wall mein peptidoglycan nahi hota?)
blocks.explanation: Bacteria aur cyanobacteria ki wall peptidoglycan ki hai; archaebacteria ki wall mukhtalif polysaccharides aur proteins ki hai, peptidoglycan nahi (3.4).

book_ref.quote: The cell wall of archaebacteria is composed of different polysaccharides and proteins

blocks.prompt:
46 The fluid mosaic model of the plasma membrane was proposed in 1972 by:
(Plasma membrane ka fluid mosaic model 1972 mein kis ne pesh kiya?)
blocks.explanation: Fluid mosaic model S.J. Singer aur Garth Nicolson ne 1972 mein pesh kiya (3.4).

book_ref.quote: It was proposed by two American biologists S.J. Singer and Garth Nicolson in 1972

blocks.prompt:
47 In the lipid bilayer of the plasma membrane:
(Plasma membrane ki lipid bilayer mein kya tarteeb hoti hai?)

options.text: hydrophobic tails andar aur hydrophilic phosphate groups bahar
heads aur tails dono cytoplasm ki taraf
tails bahar ke mahol ki taraf

blocks.explanation: Hydrophobic (paani se door rehne wali) tails andar ki taraf aur hydrophilic (paani pasand) phosphate groups bahar ki taraf hote hain (3.4).

book_ref.quote: the hydrophobic lipid tails are oriented inwards

blocks.prompt:
48 In eukaryotic plasma membranes, cholesterol molecules wedged into the bilayer:
(Eukaryotic plasma membrane mein bilayer ke beech phanse cholesterol molecules kya karte hain?)

options.text: membrane ko paani ke liye band kar dete hain
kam temperature par membrane ko fluid rakhte hain

blocks.explanation: Cholesterol molecules kam temperature par membrane ki fluidity (rawani) qaim rakhte hain (3.4).

book_ref.quote: They keep the fluidity of membrane at low temperatures

blocks.prompt:
49 The glycolipids and glycoproteins on the outer surface of the plasma membrane, collectively called glycocalyx, function as:
(Plasma membrane ki bairooni satah ke glycolipids aur glycoproteins (glycocalyx) kya kaam karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Glycocalyx cell ki pehchaan ke nishan hain jinhein doosre cells pehchante hain; yeh species, afraad aur cell types mein mukhtalif hota hai (3.4).

book_ref.quote: function as cell identification marks that are recognized by other cells

blocks.prompt:
50 According to the table of membrane composition, the membrane with the highest percentage of protein by weight is:
(Membrane composition ke table ke mutabiq kis membrane mein protein ka sab se zyada hissa hai?)

options.text: insani red blood cell ki membrane (49%)

blocks.explanation: Table ke mutabiq protein: red blood cell 49, mitochondria bahar wali 52, andar wali 76, bacteria 75 percent (3.4).

book_ref.quote: Mitochondria (inner membrane)

blocks.prompt:
51 Which molecules pass freely across the plasma membrane?
(Kaun se molecules plasma membrane se azadi se guzar jaate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chhote molecules jaise oxygen, carbon dioxide aur paani azadi se guzarte hain, magar amino acids aur sugars ka guzarna control hota hai (3.4).

book_ref.quote: the passage of larger molecules, such as amino acids and sugars, is carefully regulated

blocks.prompt:
52 The technique used to determine the atomic structure of membrane proteins is:
(Membrane proteins ki atomic structure maloom karne ki technique kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: X-ray crystallography membrane proteins ki atomic structure maloom karne ke liye istemal hoti hai (3.4).

book_ref.quote: is used to determine the atomic structure of membrane proteins

blocks.prompt:
53 Bleaching a fluorescently labelled region of the membrane with a laser and watching fluorescence return is the technique of:
(Membrane ke fluorescent hisse ko laser se bleach kar ke fluorescence ki wapsi dekhna kaun si technique hai?)
blocks.explanation: FRAP membrane proteins aur lipids ki harkat ka mutaala karta hai: bleach na hue molecules us jagah aa kar fluorescence wapas laate hain (3.4).

book_ref.quote: is used to study the mobility and dynamics of membrane proteins and lipids

blocks.prompt:
54 Lipidomics, the comprehensive analysis of membrane lipids, uses techniques like:
(Lipidomics, yani membrane lipids ka mukammal tajziya, kis technique se hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lipidomics mass spectrometry jaisi techniques se cell membrane ke lipids ka tajziya karta hai (3.4).

book_ref.quote: comprehensive analysis of lipids in the cell membrane

blocks.prompt:
55 Plasma membrane proteins that bind messenger molecules such as hormones and pass the signal inside are:
(Plasma membrane ke woh proteins jo hormones jaise messenger molecules se jur kar signal andar bhejte hain, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kuch membrane proteins receptors hain jo hormones jaise messenger molecules se jur kar signal andar bhejte hain (3.4).

book_ref.quote: which bind messenger molecules (e.g. hormones)

blocks.prompt:
56 The aqueous ground substance of the cytoplasm is called:
(Cytoplasm ke paani wale bunyadi maadde ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Cytoplasm aik paani wale bunyadi maadde, cytosol, par mushtamil hai jis mein organelles hote hain (3.4).

book_ref.quote: It consists of an aqueous ground substance, known as cytosol

blocks.prompt:
57 Glycolysis, the breakdown of glucose during aerobic respiration, takes place in the:
(Glycolysis (glucose ka tootna) kahan hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cytoplasm kayi metabolic reactions ki jagah hai, maslan glycolysis (3.4).

book_ref.quote: acts as the site for various biochemical (metabolic) reactions

blocks.prompt:
58 The spherical nucleus typically occupies about what part of a eukaryotic cell's volume?
(Gol nucleus aam tor par eukaryotic cell ke hajam ka kitna hissa gherta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nucleus aam tor par eukaryotic cell ke hajam ka taqreeban 10 percent gherta hai (3.4).

book_ref.quote: The spherical nucleus typically occupies about 10 percent of a eukaryotic

blocks.prompt:
59 The perinuclear space between the two layers of the nuclear envelope is connected with the:
(Nuclear envelope ki do tahon ke beech ki perinuclear space kis se juri hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Do tahon ke beech ki jagah (perinuclear space) rough endoplasmic reticulum se juri hoti hai (3.4).

book_ref.quote: The space between the double layers is called the perinuclear space

blocks.prompt:
60 The protein lining on the inner side of the nuclear envelope that binds chromatin and supports it is the:
(Nuclear envelope ke andar ki taraf protein ki tah jo chromatin ko sahara deti hai, kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nuclear envelope ke andar protein ki tah nuclear lamina hai jo chromatin se jur kar use sahara deti hai (3.4).

book_ref.quote: there is a protein lining, called nuclear lamina

blocks.prompt:
61 The subunit of the nuclear pore complex that anchors the pore complex into the nuclear envelope is the:
(Nuclear pore complex ka kaun sa subunit use nuclear envelope mein jamaye rakhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Annular pore ke andar gird hota hai, column deewar banata hai, ring column ke bahar juri hai, lumenal complex ko envelope mein jamata hai (3.4).

book_ref.quote: lumenal subunit (anchoring the pore complex into the nuclear envelope)

blocks.prompt:
62 Nucleoli are formed at certain sites in chromosomes called:
(Nucleoli chromosomes ki kin khaas jagahon par bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nucleoli Nucleolus Organizer Regions (NORs) par bante hain, jin ka DNA ribosomal RNA ka code rakhta hai (3.4).

book_ref.quote: called Nucleolus Organizer Regions (NORs)

blocks.prompt:
63 In the nucleolus, the fibrillar components consist of:
(Nucleolus ke fibrils kis cheez se bane hote hain?)

options.text: rRNA molecules aur un se mutaliq proteins

blocks.explanation: Complex target genes ke khaas DNA sequences se jur kar un ki transcription control karta hai, aur khaas proteins kam ya zyada bante hain (3.6).

book_ref.quote: the receptor-hormone complex binds to specific DNA sequences in target genes

blocks.prompt:
131 The membrane transport mechanism that requires no energy input is:
(Membrane transport ka kaun sa tareeqa energy nahi leta?)
blocks.explanation: Transport ke do tareeqe hain: passive (energy nahi lagti) aur active (energy lagti hai) (3.7).

book_ref.quote: passive transport (which requires no energy input)

blocks.prompt:
132 Diffusion is the net movement of a substance:
(Diffusion kisi maadde ki khalis harkat kis taraf hai?)

options.text: kam se zyada concentration ki taraf ATP se
sirf carrier proteins se ATP laga kar
zyada se kam concentration ki taraf, gradient ke saath

blocks.explanation: Diffusion zyada concentration se kam concentration ki taraf khalis harkat hai; energy nahi lagti, is liye passive hai (3.7).

book_ref.quote: from an area of higher concentration to one of lower concentration

blocks.prompt:
133 The rate of facilitated diffusion depends on:
(Facilitated diffusion ki raftaar kis par munhasir hai?)

options.text: cell mein ATP ki miqdaar par
membrane mein maujood transport proteins ki tadaad par

blocks.explanation: Facilitated diffusion ki raftaar is par munhasir hai ke membrane mein kitne transport proteins maujood hain (3.7).

book_ref.quote: The rate of facilitated diffusion depends on how many transport-protein molecules are available

blocks.prompt:
134 Gated channel proteins open or close in response to stimuli such as:
(Gated channel proteins kin stimuli par khulte ya band hote hain?)

options.text: voltage ki tabdeeli, ligand ka jurna ya mechanical dabao

blocks.explanation: Channel proteins gated ya non-gated hote hain; gated channels voltage ki tabdeeli, ligand ke jurne ya mechanical dabao par khulte/band hote hain (3.7).

book_ref.quote: Gated channels open or close in response to specific stimuli

blocks.prompt:
135 Channel proteins that facilitate the rapid transport of water molecules are:
(Paani ke molecules ko tezi se guzaarne wale channel proteins kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aquaporins channel proteins hain jo paani ko membrane se tezi se guzaarte hain (3.7).

book_ref.quote: aquaporins (facilitate the rapid transport of water molecules)

blocks.prompt:
136 Carrier proteins of facilitated diffusion can become saturated. This means:
(Facilitated diffusion ke carrier proteins saturate ho sakte hain. Is ka matlab hai:)

options.text: kam temperature par kaam chhor dete hain
jab sab carriers masroof hon to raftaar zyada se zyada hadd par ruk jaati hai

blocks.explanation: Carrier proteins bohat makhsoos hain aur saturate ho sakte hain: jab sab masroof hon to raftaar apni hadd par pohanch jaati hai (3.7).

book_ref.quote: They can become saturated, meaning there is a maximum rate of transport

blocks.prompt:
137 Simple diffusion through the lipid bilayer typically involves:
(Lipid bilayer se seedhi (simple) diffusion mein aam tor par kaun se molecules guzarte hain?)

options.text: chhote nonpolar molecules jaise oxygen aur carbon dioxide
charged ions jaise Na⁺ aur Cl⁻

blocks.explanation: Simple diffusion mein chhote nonpolar ya chikanai mein hal molecules guzarte hain; polar ya charged molecules facilitated diffusion se jaate hain (3.7).

book_ref.quote: Typically involves small, nonpolar molecules such as oxygen

blocks.prompt:
138 In osmosis, water always moves from:
(Osmosis mein paani hamesha kis taraf jata hai?)

options.text: isotonic se hypertonic ki taraf sirf ATP se
zyada solute se zyada solute ki taraf
hypotonic se hypertonic mahlool ki taraf

blocks.explanation: Paani hypotonic (kam solute) mahlool se hypertonic (zyada solute) mahlool ki taraf jata hai (3.7).

book_ref.quote: Water always moves from hypotonic solution

blocks.prompt:
139 Two solutions having equal concentrations of solutes are said to be:
(Jin do mahloolon mein solutes ka concentration barabar ho, unhein kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Tonicity: hypertonic mein solute zyada, hypotonic mein kam, isotonic mein barabar (3.7).

book_ref.quote: Isotonic solutions have equal concentrations of solutes

blocks.prompt:
140 In reverse osmosis, water is pushed through a semi-permeable membrane:
(Reverse osmosis mein paani semi-permeable membrane se kis taraf dhakela jata hai?)

options.text: baghair dabao kam se zyada solute ki taraf
bairooni dabao se zyada solute se kam solute ki taraf

blocks.explanation: Reverse osmosis mein bairooni dabao se paani zyada solute se kam solute ki taraf dhakela jata hai aur namak aur gandagi nikal jaati hai (3.7).

book_ref.quote: reverse osmosis applies external pressure to push water through a semi-permeable membrane

blocks.prompt:
141 In a resting nerve cell, the sodium-potassium pump uses ATP to move:
(Aaram ki halat wale nerve cell mein sodium-potassium pump ATP laga kar kya karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pump Na⁺ ko bahar aur K⁺ ko andar le ja kar cell ke andar K⁺ zyada aur Na⁺ kam rakhta hai (3.7).

book_ref.quote: the pump actively moves Na⁺ to the outside of the cell and K⁺ to the inside of the cell

blocks.prompt:
142 The form of endocytosis in which a cell takes in liquids as droplets is:
(Endocytosis ki woh qisam jis mein cell maaye ko qatron ki shakal mein andar leta hai, kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Phagocytosis mein cell thos cheez andar leta hai; pinocytosis mein maaye qatron ki shakal mein (3.7).

book_ref.quote: in pinocytosis, cell takes in liquids in the form of droplets

blocks.prompt:
143 Liver cells take up low-density lipoproteins (LDLs) from the blood by:
(Liver cells khoon se LDLs kis tareeqe se lete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Liver cells ke receptor proteins LDLs ko pehchan kar receptor-mediated endocytosis se andar lete hain (3.7).

book_ref.quote: the cells of liver have receptor proteins for cholesterol

blocks.prompt:
144 In exocytosis, the vesicle carrying bulky material:
(Exocytosis mein bhaari maadde wala vesicle kya karta hai?)

options.text: plasma membrane se jur kar maadda bahar chhor deta hai
lysosomes mein hazm ho jata hai
membrane se alag ho kar cytoplasm mein chala jata hai
pores se nucleus mein chala jata hai

blocks.explanation: Exocytosis mein vesicle plasma membrane tak ja kar us se jur jata hai aur apna maadda bahar chhor deta hai (3.7).

book_ref.quote: The vesicle moves to the plasma membrane and fuses with it

blocks.prompt:
145 Stem cells that can differentiate into all possible cell types, such as the zygote, are:
(Woh stem cells jo har mumkin cell type ban sakte hain, jaise zygote, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Totipotent cells (zygote aur is ki pehli chand taqseemon ke cells) har mumkin cell type ban sakte hain (3.8).

book_ref.quote: These stem cells can differentiate into all possible cell types

blocks.prompt:
146 Hematopoietic stem cells, which can become red and white blood cells or platelets, are an example of:
(Hematopoietic stem cells jo laal aur safaid khoon ke cells ya platelets ban sakte hain, kis ki misaal hain?)
blocks.explanation: Multipotent cells qareebi rishte wale cells ka khandaan bana sakte hain, maslan hematopoietic stem cells (3.8).

book_ref.quote: the hematopoietic stem cells can become red and white blood cells or platelets

blocks.prompt:
147 Adult lymphoid or myeloid stem cells, which can form a few different cell types, are:
(Adult lymphoid ya myeloid stem cells jo chand cell types bana sakte hain, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Oligopotent cells chand mukhtalif cell types bana sakte hain, maslan adult lymphoid ya myeloid stem cells (3.8).

book_ref.quote: adult lymphoid or myeloid stem cells

blocks.prompt:
148 Adult muscle stem cells produce only their own kind of cells, yet are stem cells because they can renew themselves. They are:
(Adult muscle stem cells sirf apni qisam ke cells banate hain magar khud ko nayaa kar sakte hain. Yeh kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Unipotent cells sirf apni qisam ke cells banate hain magar khud ko nayaa karte rehte hain, maslan adult muscle stem cells (3.8).

book_ref.quote: For example, adult muscle stem cells.

blocks.prompt:
149 Embryonic stem cells (ESCs) are derived from:
(Embryonic stem cells (ESCs) kahan se haasil kiye jaate hain?)

options.text: adult somatic cells ko reprogram kar ke
blastocysts ka andar wala cell mass

blocks.explanation: ESCs blastocysts (ibtidai embryo) ke andar ke cell mass se aate hain aur pluripotent hain (3.8).

book_ref.quote: ESCs are derived from the inner cell mass of blastocysts

blocks.prompt:
150 Adult stem cells, found in bone marrow, fat and blood, are:
(Bone marrow, charbi aur khoon mein paye jaane wale adult stem cells kis qisam ke hain?)
blocks.explanation: Adult stem cells multipotent hain: apne asal tissue se mutaliq mehdood cell types banate hain (3.8).

book_ref.quote: such as bone marrow, fat, and blood

blocks.prompt:
151 Induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) are generated in the lab by:
(Induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) lab mein kaise banaye jaate hain?)

options.text: blastocyst ka andar wala cell mass le kar
adult somatic cells ko khaas transcription factors se reprogram kar ke
bone marrow se cells nikaal kar

blocks.explanation: iPSCs adult somatic cells ko khaas transcription factors se reprogram kar ke pluripotent halat mein laa kar banaye jaate hain (3.8).

book_ref.quote: by reprogramming adult somatic cells to a pluripotent state

blocks.prompt:
152 Using stem cells to create models of human diseases for drug testing helps by:
(Dawaon ki testing ke liye stem cells se insani bimariyon ke models banane ka kya faida hai?)

options.text: janwaron ke models par inhisaar kam kar ke
immune rejection ka khatra barha kar
har testing ki zaroorat khatam kar ke

blocks.explanation: Stem cells se bane bimari ke models dawaon ki behtar testing dete hain aur janwaron par inhisaar kam karte hain (3.8).

book_ref.quote: reducing the reliance on animal models

blocks.prompt:
153 In regenerative medicine, stem cells are used to treat conditions such as:
(Regenerative medicine mein stem cells kin bimariyon ke ilaaj mein istemal hote hain?)

options.text: spinal cord injury, type 1 diabetes aur Parkinson's disease

blocks.explanation: Stem cells kharab tissues ki marammat ya tabdeeli kar sakte hain, is liye spinal cord injury, type 1 diabetes, Parkinson's aur dil ki bimari mein istemal hote hain (3.8).

book_ref.quote: spinal cord injuries, type 1 diabetes
